requirements.requirement: The system must define a TypeScript interface that includes a numeric overallScore field.
The system must define a measures array in the interface where each element represents an individual scoring measure.
The system must ensure each measure object includes a name field of type string.
The system must ensure each measure object includes a score field of type number.
The system must ensure each measure object includes a weight field of type number.
The system must include a contribution field per measure representing its contribution to the overall score as a number.
The system must define the interface such that the sum of contributions can be computed from the measures array.
The system must ensure the interface is compatible with structured rendering expectations of MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must define all fields in the interface using explicit TypeScript types (no implicit any).
The system must support optional fields for measures to allow partial backend responses without type failure.
The system must allow the measures array to be empty without causing type errors.
The system must enforce that overallScore is present even if measures are empty.
The system must define the interface in a reusable location accessible by MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must ensure the interface can represent both provider and clinical trial scoring outputs.
The system must not throw a TypeScript compilation error when a measure is missing weight or contribution fields (exception path).
The system must not throw a TypeScript compilation error when the backend payload includes additional unknown fields (exception path).
